subject: Executive alignment: VP/CTO attendance window for GreenLine integration demo
messages:
From: Katherine Li <katherine.li@greenline.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark D'Souza <mdsouza@greenline.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: GreenLine: CTO-level demo request & timing

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the intro. We’re excited to see Redwood in action for our upcoming integration planning. Our CTO (Rajesh Menon) and VP of Product (Mark D'Souza) have requested an exec-level demo focused on latency, security controls, and dedicated capacity options. Ideally we'd do a 45–60 min session that covers:

- Executive overview (10 min)
- Architecture & deployment options (20 min)
- Q&A + next steps (15–30 min)

Do you have windows the week of May 6–10? Rajesh's calendar is tight; he prefers mornings PT. If you can propose 2 x 60-min windows we'll pick one.

Thanks,
Katherine
Katherine Li
Head of Integrations | GreenLine Systems
katherine.li@greenline.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Li <katherine.li@greenline.com>
Cc: Mark D'Souza <mdsouza@greenline.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenLine: CTO-level demo request & timing

Katherine — great to hear, and thanks for the clear agenda.

We can cover latency, security, and Dedicated/Private options in a 60-minute executive-run demo. Proposed windows (PT):

- Tue, May 7 — 09:00–10:00
- Wed, May 8 — 10:30–11:30

If those don't work for Rajesh, I can also do Thu May 9 at 08:30.

Looping in Soojin (SE) for the architecture + live demo, and Ben (sales lead) for the executive alignment.

A couple quick asks so we tailor the session correctly:
- Will Rajesh want any deep-dive on model quantization or runtime kernels?
- Any compliance checklist items we should prioritize (SOC2 / VPC specifics)?

I’ll hold the Tue and Wed slots tentatively until you confirm. Once you pick a window I’ll send a calendar invite and a short exec brief.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
(650) 555-0123

Thanks for looping me in.

Quick notes from engineering side:
- We can run a focused latency demo (real inference trace for your typical seq lengths) — will need a sample prompt set from you to mirror production.
- For Dedicated/Private we’ll show deployment options and tradeoffs for throughput vs cost.

If Rajesh is constrained we can do the exec overview with a separate deep-dive with our infra team; otherwise we’ll keep the demo high-level and reserve 10–15 minutes for architecture Q+A.

Availability (PT) I can make work besides Wed morning:
- Tue May 7 — 09:00
- Wed May 8 — 10:30 (tight)
- Thu May 9 — 08:30

If Katherine confirms Tue 09:00 I’ll prepare a short 4-slide arc and a live runbook.

— Soojin
